name: claim_item
description: Claim an item as the agent you are, or renew your own claim by calling this again before expiresAt. Returns {claim:{expiresAt,renewed},item:<as get_item>}. A claim you abandon blocks the item until it expires: finish with handoff_item or release_item. Refusals: not_claimable: (it names who holds it and until when), denied:, archived:.
